import json, subprocess, sys, copy

def run(raw):
    if isinstance(raw, (dict, list)):
        raw = json.dumps(raw).encode()
    elif isinstance(raw, str):
        raw = raw.encode()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/project/solver.py'], input=raw,
                       capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode(), p.stderr.decode()

base = {'primitive': 'allreduce', 'mode': 2, 'root': 0, 'segments': 4, 'words': 2,
        'capacity': 4, 'start': 0, 'events': []}

    c = dict(base)
    c.update(kw)
    return c

    rc, out, err = run(raw)
